comments.author: Io
comments.body: How to get presents from bar-maids?

comments.author: Beatrice
comments.body: Befriend them by buying them drinks and giving them gifts, perfume is the cheapest option but they will also take a lot of other equipment/items. stuff that you have almost used up (e.g Durability 2/30) is an idea.

comments.author: Chester
comments.body: How much you have to gift maid to get present?

comments.author: Erda
comments.body: I have given hundreds of gifts to multiple barmaids and never got a present from any of them. I guess they just don't like me.. :(

comments.author: Erda
comments.body: I used to, but never got anything out of it so I dropped it at the same time I stopped giving the equivalent of a few hundred million ducats in items to the barmaids.

comments.author: Lena
comments.body: you doesnt have to have persuasion skill to get the gift. you only can get the gift from the barmaid from the 6 capital tavern n instanbul. i tried giving 3 taiwanese hairpin n i got the gift. :)

comments.author: Aguirre
comments.body: Drink; give presents; then drink again. It's the second drink that seems to trigger the gift.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: You're quite right. Though, some presents are worth more than others to barmaids; you can usually tell if they liked a gift by how much or how little they react to the gifts being given. I finished the present MA by using three or four Admiral Coats from Pisa for each barmaid.

comments.author: Aguirre
comments.body: I have noticed that as well. You can't just continue to give them junk from the item shop. I found that it's a good way to get rid of low durability items as well (amulets, jewelry, hairpins). Jade necklace with +1 sewing seems to be the most useful of all the gifts.
